constant_columns.treatment_protocol_ch1: Mice were administered a vehicle or senolytic cocktail containing 5 mg/kg dasatinib and 50 mg/kg quercetin through gavage on days 7 and 10 of the 14-day mechanical overload using 20-gauge disposable polypropylene feeding tubes.

Following anesthetization with 5% isoflurane, 1/4-1/3 of the soleus and the gastrocnemius muscles were surgically excised via an incision on the dorsal aspect of the hind limb.
